text: にんげんと　おなじように　ポケモンも　いきてるの！

structure.jp: にんげんと　おなじように
structure.en: in the same way as humans

patterns.name: 〜とおなじように
patterns.span: にんげんと　おなじように
patterns.explanation: と　おなじように means 'in the same way as'; と here is 'as', not 'and'. にんげんと　おなじように = 'just like humans'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いる says a state is going on now. てる is the short spoken form of ている. いきてる = 'are alive'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft, womanly form of のだ and presses a point as an explanation. いきてるの！ = 'they're alive, you see!'.
